VP_ZINK_cl12_embedded.description: Minimum requirements for rusticl to report OpenCL 1.2 with the embedded profile on Zink. Zink exposes at most 32 sampled images per stage, fewer than the 128 of the full profile, so rusticl reports the embedded profile for devices with image support.
